# SIA.HAUS License

> SIA.HAUS License lets venue operators subscribe to media art instead of commissioning it. Rather than ordering a new piece, an operator licenses work SIA.HAUS has already produced, month by month, and shows it in their own space.

## How it works

SIA.HAUS runs all four stages in-house — planning, pre-production, production and operation. Nothing is split out to subcontractors, so the rights to what we make stay with us, and that body of work is what we license.

01. **Produce** — We take commissioned projects from planning through to on-site operation ourselves. The master assets and the rights remain with the studio.
02. **Catalog** — Finished works are standardized and held in a catalog, stored so that resolution, ratio and runtime can be re-rendered to fit a given space.
03. **Subscribe** — Once an operator picks a plan, we supply the screening rights and the files for that work, and support swaps and re-renders for the length of the contract.

## Works available to license

Resolution is re-rendered to match your screen specification.

- **Blooming of Time and Space · Pulse of Seoul** — Media art. The movement of the city rendered as density of light, treating the whole screen as a single pulse.
- **ARIA** (2025) — Kinetic display. A kinetic piece in which the physically moving display structure and the moving image were designed together.
- **Grand Josun** (2025) — Anamorphic media facade. An anamorphic media facade built around the corner of the building so that it reads as three-dimensional.
- **ARFA** — IP gallery project. A gallery project developed on SIA.HAUS's own IP. It is built as a series, which suits rotation.
- **Kim Tschang-Yeul Atelier** (2026) — Immersive exhibition. Immersive exhibition content that moves the artist's working world into the space as a whole.

## Plans

- **Single** — 1 work · 1 space. Subscription fee on enquiry.
- **Collection** — 5 works in rotation · 1 space. Subscription fee on enquiry.
- **Estate** — Full catalog · multiple spaces. Subscription fee on enquiry.

Subscription fees are quoted per case, based on screen dimensions, how many works you select, and contract length. Get in touch and we will confirm the terms for your space.
